description: Projet de PPRI Savoureuse - Département du Territoire de Belfort - 1997 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.territoiredebelfort.fr. A flood risk prevention plan or flood risk prevention plan (similar to: "PPRI") is a document emanating from the public authority, intended to assess areas that may suffer from floods and proposing technical, legal and human remedies to deal with them. It is a strategic, cartographic and regulatory document. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Savourous PPRI project - Department of the Territory of Belfort - 1997" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include zone inondable, inondations. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
